wages.text: She supports raising the minimum wage and strengthening unions.
wages.quote: increase union density, raise the minimum wage, fund social security, to create and protect job opportunities

debt.text: Her economic platform lists funding Social Security among its priorities.
debt.quote: raise the minimum wage, fund social security, to create and protect job opportunities, and more

housing.text: Her housing platform calls for protecting tenants, funding public housing, and building affordable housing.
housing.quote: Darializa will fight to protect all tenants, fully fund Section 8, fully fund NYCHA, prevent deed theft, and build affordable housing.

schools.text: She calls for free, quality public education from childcare through college.
schools.quote: Darializa will fight for our right to free, quality public education from childcare to college.

immigration.text: She calls for abolishing the deportation system, expanding citizenship pathways, and free legal representation for immigrants.
immigration.quote: Darializa will fight to abolish the deportation machine, expand pathways to citizenship, secure free legal representation for immigrants, and more.

health.text: She campaigns for Medicare for All, a free universal system covering a broad range of care.
health.quote: Medicare for All: a free, universal system that covers primary and mental health care, dental, vision, hearing, reproductive care, long-term care, and lower prescription costs

immigration.text: Williams says he would repeal New York City's sanctuary status and stresses that immigration enforcement is the law of the land, while building his framework on the Dignity Act.
immigration.quote: Immigration enforcement isn't going anywhere—it is the law of the land.

voting.text: Williams calls for enacting the SAVE Act and requiring Voter ID and proof of citizenship to vote.
voting.quote: Say YES to the SAVE Act & Voter ID
